---- MODULE W4Od10m4p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets

Controllers == {"A", "B"}
Blocks == {"b1", "b2"}
MaxEpoch == 2
Cap == 2

VARIABLES queue, occupied, gepoch, lepoch, registered

vars == <<queue, occupied, gepoch, lepoch, registered>>

Requests == [ctrl: Controllers, blk: Blocks, ep: 0..MaxEpoch]

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in Seq(Requests)
    /\ Len(queue) <= Cap
    /\ occupied \in [Blocks -> Controllers \cup {"none"}]
    /\ gepoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ lepoch \in [Controllers -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ registered \in [Controllers -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ queue = << >>
    /\ occupied = [b \in Blocks |-> "none"]
    /\ gepoch = 0
    /\ lepoch = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
    /\ registered = [c \in Controllers |-> FALSE]

Register(c) ==
    /\ lepoch' = [lepoch EXCEPT ![c] = gepoch]
    /\ registered' = [registered EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, occupied, gepoch>>

Submit(c, b) ==
    /\ registered[c]
    /\ lepoch[c] = gepoch
    /\ Len(queue) < Cap
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, [ctrl |-> c, blk |-> b, ep |-> gepoch])
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupied, gepoch, lepoch, registered>>

Grant ==
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ LET r == Head(queue) IN
         /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
         /\ IF r.ep = gepoch /\ registered[r.ctrl] /\ occupied[r.blk] = "none"
              THEN occupied' = [occupied EXCEPT ![r.blk] = r.ctrl]
              ELSE occupied' = occupied
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gepoch, lepoch, registered>>

Release(c, b) ==
    /\ occupied[b] = c
    /\ occupied' = [occupied EXCEPT ![b] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, gepoch, lepoch, registered>>

BumpEpoch ==
    /\ gepoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ gepoch' = gepoch + 1
    /\ queue' = << >>
    /\ occupied' = [b \in Blocks |-> "none"]
    /\ registered' = [c \in Controllers |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED lepoch

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Register(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, b \in Blocks : Submit(c, b)
    \/ Grant
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, b \in Blocks : Release(c, b)
    \/ BumpEpoch

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleOrUnauthorized ==
    /\ Len(queue) <= Cap
    /\ \A i \in 1..Len(queue) :
         /\ queue[i].ep = gepoch
         /\ registered[queue[i].ctrl]
    /\ \A b \in Blocks :
         occupied[b] # "none" =>
            /\ registered[occupied[b]]
            /\ lepoch[occupied[b]] = gepoch
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleOrUnauthorized
nl:
A subway signalling system controls a small pool of track blocks that trains must be granted before entering. Two independent signalling controllers, A and B, run side by side and draw movement authorities from the very same pool of blocks; neither is a master. A controller does not seize a block directly. Instead it appends a movement-authority request to a shared bounded work queue. The queue applies backpressure: once it holds its capacity of pending requests, no controller may submit another until the queue drains.

Each request is stamped with the identity of the controller that issued it and with that controller's current authority epoch. A central interlocking periodically bumps the global authority epoch (for example after a track fault), which retroactively invalidates every request and grant made under the old epoch. A controller catches up by re-registering, which refreshes its local epoch to the global one; only a registered controller with a current epoch is authorized to submit.

The interlocking drains the queue one request at a time. It grants a block only if that block is currently free and the request at the head of the queue is still fresh (its stamped epoch equals the global epoch and its issuer is still registered); a stale request at the head is simply discarded. A controller may release a block it holds.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every request waiting in the queue carries the global epoch and was issued by a registered controller, and every occupied block is held by a registered controller whose local epoch equals the global epoch, so no stale or unauthorized participant ever holds or is queued for a block.

---- MODULE W4Od9m8p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Operators == {"o1", "o2"}
Feeders == {"f1", "f2"}
Region == "reg"

RegionOf(f) == Region

VARIABLES coarse, fine, relayHolder, relayFeeder, override

vars == <<coarse, fine, relayHolder, relayFeeder, override>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in [{Region} -> Operators \cup {"none"}]
    /\ fine \in [Feeders -> Operators \cup {"none"}]
    /\ relayHolder \in Operators \cup {"none"}
    /\ relayFeeder \in Feeders \cup {"none"}
    /\ override \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ coarse = [r \in {Region} |-> "none"]
    /\ fine = [f \in Feeders |-> "none"]
    /\ relayHolder = "none"
    /\ relayFeeder = "none"
    /\ override = FALSE

AcquireCoarse(o) ==
    /\ coarse[Region] = "none"
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![Region] = o]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, relayHolder, relayFeeder, override>>

AcquireFine(o, f) ==
    /\ coarse[RegionOf(f)] = o
    /\ fine[f] = "none"
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![f] = o]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, relayHolder, relayFeeder, override>>

SeizeRelay(o, f) ==
    /\ relayHolder = "none"
    /\ fine[f] = o
    /\ relayHolder' = o
    /\ relayFeeder' = f
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, override>>

ReleaseRelay(o) ==
    /\ relayHolder = o
    /\ relayHolder' = "none"
    /\ relayFeeder' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, override>>

ReleaseFine(o, f) ==
    /\ fine[f] = o
    /\ ~(relayHolder = o /\ relayFeeder = f)
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![f] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, relayHolder, relayFeeder, override>>

ReleaseCoarse(o) ==
    /\ coarse[Region] = o
    /\ \A f \in Feeders : fine[f] # o
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![Region] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, relayHolder, relayFeeder, override>>

ArmOverride ==
    /\ override = FALSE
    /\ override' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, relayHolder, relayFeeder>>

AdminSeize(o, f) ==
    /\ override = TRUE
    /\ relayHolder = "none"
    /\ relayHolder' = o
    /\ relayFeeder' = f
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, override>>

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Operators : AcquireCoarse(o)
    \/ \E o \in Operators, f \in Feeders : AcquireFine(o, f)
    \/ \E o \in Operators, f \in Feeders : SeizeRelay(o, f)
    \/ \E o \in Operators : ReleaseRelay(o)
    \/ \E o \in Operators, f \in Feeders : ReleaseFine(o, f)
    \/ \E o \in Operators : ReleaseCoarse(o)
    \/ ArmOverride
    \/ \E o \in Operators, f \in Feeders : AdminSeize(o, f)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RelayMutexHierarchy ==
    /\ (relayHolder = "none") <=> (relayFeeder = "none")
    /\ \A f \in Feeders : fine[f] # "none" => coarse[RegionOf(f)] = fine[f]
    /\ (relayHolder # "none" /\ ~override) =>
          (relayFeeder # "none" /\ fine[relayFeeder] = relayHolder)
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RelayMutexHierarchy
nl:
A power-grid load shedder protects a substation that has a single critical shed relay: only one operator may be operating that relay at any instant. To reach the relay an operator must descend a two-level lock hierarchy. First the operator takes the coarse lock on the region. Holding the region's coarse lock, the operator may then take the fine lock on one specific feeder within that region. The locks must always be acquired coarse-before-fine and released fine-before-coarse.

Only after holding the fine lock on a feeder may the operator seize the shed relay and begin shedding that feeder. Because the relay is the single critical resource, at most one operator operates it at a time; a second operator, even holding its own feeder's fine lock, must wait until the relay is free. When finished the operator releases the relay, then the fine lock, then the coarse lock.

There is a privileged admin override. When the override is armed, an authorized emergency action may seize the relay for a feeder directly, without descending the lock hierarchy, so that shedding can happen during a fault even if the normal locks are held by a stuck operator.

SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one operator ever operates the shed relay at once; whenever a feeder's fine lock is held it is held by the same operator that holds its region's coarse lock; and whenever the relay is held through the normal path (override not armed) the holder is exactly the operator holding the fine lock on the feeder being shed.

---- MODULE W4Od8m1p5t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Nodes == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
Students == {"s1", "s2"}
Sections == {"c1", "c2"}
SharedCap == 2

Succ(n) == CASE n = "n1" -> "n2"
             [] n = "n2" -> "n3"
             [] n = "n3" -> "n1"

VARIABLES holder, assigned, poolUsed, committed

vars == <<holder, assigned, poolUsed, committed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Nodes
    /\ assigned \in [Students -> Sections \cup {"none"}]
    /\ poolUsed \in 0..SharedCap
    /\ committed \in [Students -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ holder = "n1"
    /\ assigned = [s \in Students |-> "none"]
    /\ poolUsed = 0
    /\ committed = [s \in Students |-> FALSE]

PassToken ==
    /\ holder' = Succ(holder)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assigned, poolUsed, committed>>

Reserve(n, s, sec) ==
    /\ holder = n
    /\ assigned[s] = "none"
    /\ poolUsed < SharedCap
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![s] = sec]
    /\ poolUsed' = poolUsed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, committed>>

Cancel(n, s) ==
    /\ holder = n
    /\ assigned[s] # "none"
    /\ ~committed[s]
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
    /\ poolUsed' = poolUsed - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, committed>>

Commit(n, s) ==
    /\ holder = n
    /\ assigned[s] # "none"
    /\ ~committed[s]
    /\ committed' = [committed EXCEPT ![s] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, assigned, poolUsed>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, s \in Students, sec \in Sections : Reserve(n, s, sec)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, s \in Students : Cancel(n, s)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, s \in Students : Commit(n, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

EnrollOnce ==
    /\ poolUsed <= SharedCap
    /\ \A s \in Students : committed[s] => assigned[s] \in Sections
    /\ \A s \in Students : assigned[s] = "none" => ~committed[s]
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT EnrollOnce
nl:
A university course-registration system runs several registration terminals arranged in a token ring. A single token circulates around the ring; only the terminal currently holding the token may touch the shared seat pool, which gives it exclusive access while it works. When done, a terminal passes the token to its successor in the ring.

Two independent course sections, c1 and c2, are offered but they draw their seats from one shared pool of a fixed capacity; a seat consumed by either section is a seat gone from the common pool. Enrolling a student is a two-step, ultimately irreversible action. The token-holding terminal first reserves a seat for a student in one section, tentatively consuming a pool seat. It may then either cancel that reservation (returning the seat to the pool) or commit it, which finalizes the enrollment. A committed enrollment is irreversible: it can never be cancelled, so its seat is gone for good, and each student can hold at most one seat at a time.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of consumed seats never exceeds the shared pool capacity, every finalized (committed) enrollment still holds exactly one section seat, and no student is ever marked committed without holding a reserved seat.

---- MODULE W4Od0m1p5t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets

Nodes == {"d1", "d2"}
Surgeries == {"s1", "s2"}
MaxCap == 2

Succ(n) == IF n = "d1" THEN "d2" ELSE "d1"

Active(status) == {s \in Surgeries : status[s] # "unbooked"}

VARIABLES holder, status, capacity, clog

vars == <<holder, status, capacity, clog>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Nodes
    /\ status \in [Surgeries -> {"unbooked", "held", "confirmed"}]
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ clog \in Seq(Surgeries)

Init ==
    /\ holder = "d1"
    /\ status = [s \in Surgeries |-> "unbooked"]
    /\ capacity = 1
    /\ clog = << >>

PassToken ==
    /\ holder' = Succ(holder)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, capacity, clog>>

OpenTheatre ==
    /\ capacity < MaxCap
    /\ capacity' = capacity + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, status, clog>>

CloseTheatre ==
    /\ capacity > Cardinality(Active(status))
    /\ capacity' = capacity - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, status, clog>>

Hold(n, s) ==
    /\ holder = n
    /\ status[s] = "unbooked"
    /\ Cardinality(Active(status)) < capacity
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![s] = "held"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, capacity, clog>>

Release(n, s) ==
    /\ holder = n
    /\ status[s] = "held"
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![s] = "unbooked"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, capacity, clog>>

Confirm(n, s) ==
    /\ holder = n
    /\ status[s] = "held"
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![s] = "confirmed"]
    /\ clog' = Append(clog, s)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, capacity>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ OpenTheatre
    \/ CloseTheatre
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, s \in Surgeries : Hold(n, s)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, s \in Surgeries : Release(n, s)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, s \in Surgeries : Confirm(n, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BookOnce ==
    /\ Cardinality(Active(status)) <= capacity
    /\ \A i, j \in 1..Len(clog) : clog[i] = clog[j] => i = j
====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BookOnce
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler coordinates several booking desks arranged in a token ring. A single token travels the ring, and only the desk holding the token may change the schedule, giving it exclusive access. When finished the desk forwards the token to the next desk.

The number of operating rooms available is not fixed: theatres open and close during the day, so the capacity changes at runtime. A theatre may be opened, raising capacity, and a theatre may be closed, lowering capacity, but a theatre can only be closed when it is not needed, that is, only while spare capacity exists above the surgeries currently occupying rooms.

Booking a surgery is irreversible once confirmed. The token-holding desk first holds a room for a surgery (occupying capacity), and may then release that hold, or confirm it. Confirmation is final and is recorded once in a confirmation log; a confirmed surgery can never be un-booked, and the same surgery must never be confirmed twice.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of surgeries occupying rooms never exceeds the current room capacity, and no surgery ever appears more than once in the confirmation log, so each irreversible booking happens at most once.

---- MODULE W4Od2m1p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Nodes == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
Robots == {"r1", "r2", "r3"}
Cap == 2

Succ(n) == CASE n = "n1" -> "n2" [] n = "n2" -> "n3" [] n = "n3" -> "n1"

VARIABLES holder, requests, grants, zone

vars == <<holder, requests, grants, zone>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Nodes
    /\ requests \subseteq Robots
    /\ grants \subseteq Robots
    /\ zone \subseteq Robots

Init ==
    /\ holder = "n1"
    /\ requests = {}
    /\ grants = {}
    /\ zone = {}

PassToken ==
    /\ holder' = Succ(holder)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<requests, grants, zone>>

SendReq(r) ==
    /\ r \notin requests
    /\ r \notin grants
    /\ r \notin zone
    /\ requests' = requests \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, grants, zone>>

Grant(n, r) ==
    /\ holder = n
    /\ r \in requests
    /\ Cardinality(grants \cup zone) < Cap
    /\ grants' = grants \cup {r}
    /\ requests' = requests \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, zone>>

EnterZone(r) ==
    /\ r \in grants
    /\ zone' = zone \cup {r}
    /\ grants' = grants \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, requests>>

Leave(r) ==
    /\ r \in zone
    /\ zone' = zone \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, requests, grants>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E r \in Robots : SendReq(r)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, r \in Robots : Grant(n, r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : EnterZone(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Leave(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapSafe ==
    /\ Cardinality(grants \cup zone) <= Cap
    /\ requests \cap grants = {}
    /\ grants \cap zone = {}
    /\ requests \cap zone = {}
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapSafe
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet shares a charging zone that can hold only a bounded number of robots at once. A ring of dock controllers coordinates admission: a single token circulates the ring, and only the controller currently holding the token may issue admissions, giving it exclusive control of the zone's capacity. The token is passed around the ring.

Robots communicate by messages that can be reordered: there is no ordering guarantee, so pending requests and issued grants sit in unordered mailboxes and may be acted upon in any order. A robot first sends an entry request. The token-holding controller may pick any pending request and issue a grant, reserving a capacity slot at that moment. The grant travels back to the robot and, because messages are reordered, may be consumed in any order; consuming a grant moves the robot physically into the zone. A robot inside the zone may leave, freeing its slot.

Capacity is reserved from the moment a grant is issued until the robot leaves, so a grant in flight still counts against the zone.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of robots that hold a grant or are already inside the zone never exceeds the zone capacity, and no robot is simultaneously in two of the request, granted, and inside states.

---- MODULE W4Od6m3p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Controllers == {"c1", "c2"}
MaxUpdates == 3

VARIABLES leader, alive, record, ledger, override

vars == <<leader, alive, record, ledger, override>>

Total(f) == f["c1"] + f["c2"] + f["admin"]

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Controllers \cup {"none"}
    /\ alive \in [Controllers -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ record \in 0..(3 * MaxUpdates)
    /\ ledger \in [Controllers \cup {"admin"} -> 0..MaxUpdates]
    /\ override \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ alive = [c \in Controllers |-> TRUE]
    /\ record = 0
    /\ ledger = [c \in Controllers \cup {"admin"} |-> 0]
    /\ override = FALSE

Elect(c) ==
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ alive[c]
    /\ leader' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, record, ledger, override>>

Crash(c) ==
    /\ alive[c]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ leader' = IF leader = c THEN "none" ELSE leader
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, ledger, override>>

Recover(c) ==
    /\ ~alive[c]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, record, ledger, override>>

Commit(c) ==
    /\ leader = c
    /\ alive[c]
    /\ ledger[c] < MaxUpdates
    /\ record' = record + 1
    /\ ledger' = [ledger EXCEPT ![c] = ledger[c] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, override>>

ArmOverride ==
    /\ override = FALSE
    /\ override' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, record, ledger>>

AdminCommit ==
    /\ override = TRUE
    /\ ledger["admin"] < MaxUpdates
    /\ record' = record + 1
    /\ ledger' = [ledger EXCEPT !["admin"] = ledger["admin"] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, override>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Elect(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Recover(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Commit(c)
    \/ ArmOverride
    \/ AdminCommit

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    /\ record = Total(ledger)
    /\ leader # "none" => alive[leader]
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper keeps a single shared dispatch record: a running tally of how many hall calls the bank has committed to serve. Several car controllers could write to it, so the controllers run a leader election: at most one controller is the leader at a time, and only the leader may commit updates to the shared record. If the current leader crashes, the leadership is vacated and another live controller can be elected, providing failover.

To guarantee no lost updates, the shared record is reconciled against a per-controller ledger of how many calls each controller has personally committed. Every committed update both bumps the shared tally and credits the committing controller's own ledger by exactly one, so the shared record must always equal the sum of every controller's individual contributions; a lost update would show up as a mismatch.

There is a privileged admin override. When armed, an operator may commit an update directly, without being the elected leader, for emergency recall. Such an override commit is still accounted honestly: it bumps the shared tally and credits an admin ledger, so it too cannot be a lost update.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared dispatch record always equals the sum of all per-controller and admin contribution ledgers, so no committed update is ever lost, and there is never more than one elected leader.

INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A subway signalling system maintains one shared occupancy record: a tally of how many block reservations have been committed across the line. Two independent signalling instances, I1 and I2, run side by side and both draw from and write to this one shared pool of blocks; neither owns it. To keep their writes from clobbering one another, an instance must descend a two-level lock hierarchy before committing: first take the coarse lock on the whole line, then, while holding it, take the fine lock on a specific block. Locks are always taken coarse-before-fine.

Only while holding the fine lock on a block may an instance commit a reservation for it. Committing bumps the shared occupancy tally and, in the same step, credits that instance's own ledger by one. The shared record is therefore reconciled against the per-instance ledgers: it must always equal the sum of both instances' committed counts, so no update is ever lost even though two instances share the pool. When finished an instance releases the fine lock, then the coarse lock.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared occupancy record always equals the sum of the two instances' commit ledgers, so no committed update is lost; and whenever a block's fine lock is held, the same instance also holds the line's coarse lock.

EXTENDS Integers

Participants == {"p1", "p2"}
MaxRounds == 2

VARIABLES phase, vote, ackd, crane, rounds

vars == <<phase, vote, ackd, crane, rounds>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "preparing", "committed", "aborted"}
    /\ vote \in [Participants -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ ackd \in [Participants -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ crane \in {"free", "held"}
    /\ rounds \in 0..MaxRounds

Init ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ vote = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
    /\ ackd = [p \in Participants |-> FALSE]
    /\ crane = "free"
    /\ rounds = 0

StartPrepare ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ crane = "free"
    /\ rounds < MaxRounds
    /\ phase' = "preparing"
    /\ vote' = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
    /\ ackd' = [p \in Participants |-> FALSE]
    /\ rounds' = rounds + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED crane

CastVote(p, v) ==

nl:
A subway signalling system allocates track blocks to trains using optimistic locking with retry. Each block carries an owner (a train, or none) and a version number that is bumped on every ownership change. A train allocates a block optimistically: observing the block currently free, it reads the block's current version, recording that snapshot as a pending attempt. Later it tries to commit: the commit succeeds only if the block is still free and its version still equals the snapshot the train read. If either has changed, the attempt is stale; the train abandons it and may retry from a fresh read.

Because every ownership change bumps the version, any competing attempt that read an older version is guaranteed to detect the conflict and fail its commit, so two trains can never both be granted the same block.

SAFETY PROPERTY: For every train with a pending attempt on a block that is already owned, the block's current version differs from the version the train snapshotted, so no stale attempt can commit and the same block is never doubly allocated.

A library book reservation system tracks a fixed number of copies of a title across several branch servers. The copies are a conserved quantity: none is ever created or destroyed, only moved among three pools, available, on-hold, and checked-out. The branch servers run a leader election with failover: at most one server is leader, and only the current leader (while alive) may move copies. If the leader is not alive, another live server may be elected.

Patron actions move one copy at a time: a leader may place an available copy on hold, check out an on-hold copy, return a checked-out copy to available, or cancel a hold back to available. One server is allowed to crash silently, with no notification, and at most one server is crashed at a time; a crashed leader simply triggers failover to a live server. A crashed server may later recover. No matter what crashes or elections happen, every copy is always counted in exactly one of the three pools.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The available, on-hold, and checked-out copy counts always sum to the fixed total, and at most one server is ever crashed.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od5m8p3t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Workers == {"w1", "w2"}
Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
Players == {"p1"}
Region == "reg"

RegionOf(s) == Region

VARIABLES coarse, fine, slotOwner, allocatedBy, override

vars == <<coarse, fine, slotOwner, allocatedBy, override>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in [{Region} -> Workers \cup {"none"}]
    /\ fine \in [Slots -> Workers \cup {"none"}]
    /\ slotOwner \in [Slots -> Players \cup {"none"}]
    /\ allocatedBy \in [Slots -> Workers \cup {"admin", "none"}]
    /\ override \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ coarse = [r \in {Region} |-> "none"]
    /\ fine = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]
    /\ slotOwner = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]
    /\ allocatedBy = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]
    /\ override = FALSE

AcquireCoarse(w) ==
    /\ coarse[Region] = "none"
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![Region] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, slotOwner, allocatedBy, override>>

AcquireFine(w, s) ==
    /\ coarse[RegionOf(s)] = w
    /\ fine[s] = "none"
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, slotOwner, allocatedBy, override>>

Allocate(w, s, p) ==
    /\ fine[s] = w
    /\ slotOwner[s] = "none"
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ allocatedBy' = [allocatedBy EXCEPT ![s] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, override>>

Deallocate(w, s) ==
    /\ fine[s] = w
    /\ slotOwner[s] # "none"
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
    /\ allocatedBy' = [allocatedBy EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, override>>

ReleaseFine(w, s) ==
    /\ fine[s] = w
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, slotOwner, allocatedBy, override>>

ReleaseCoarse(w) ==
    /\ coarse[Region] = w
    /\ \A s \in Slots : fine[s] # w
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![Region] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, slotOwner, allocatedBy, override>>

ArmOverride ==
    /\ override = FALSE
    /\ override' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, slotOwner, allocatedBy>>

DisarmOverride ==
    /\ override = TRUE
    /\ override' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, slotOwner, allocatedBy>>

AdminForce(s, p) ==
    /\ override = TRUE
    /\ slotOwner[s] = "none"
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ allocatedBy' = [allocatedBy EXCEPT ![s] = "admin"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, override>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers : AcquireCoarse(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, s \in Slots : AcquireFine(w, s)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, s \in Slots, p \in Players : Allocate(w, s, p)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, s \in Slots : Deallocate(w, s)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, s \in Slots : ReleaseFine(w, s)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : ReleaseCoarse(w)
    \/ ArmOverride
    \/ DisarmOverride
    \/ \E s \in Slots, p \in Players : AdminForce(s, p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : fine[s] # "none" => coarse[RegionOf(s)] = fine[s]
    /\ \A s \in Slots : (slotOwner[s] # "none") <=> (allocatedBy[s] # "none")
====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker allocates player slots using a two-level lock hierarchy. To touch a slot a worker must first take the coarse lock on the slot's region, and only while holding it may take the fine lock on a specific slot; locks are always taken coarse-before-fine and released fine-before-coarse. Holding a slot's fine lock, a worker may allocate the slot to a player if it is currently empty, or deallocate a slot it filled. Each allocation is stamped with who performed it, so a slot is recorded as owned exactly when it has an allocator, and no slot ever holds two players, so the same slot is never doubly allocated.

There is a privileged admin override. When armed, an operator may force a slot's allocation directly, bypassing the lock hierarchy, and the forced allocation is stamped as admin-made. The override may be armed and later disarmed.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a slot's fine lock is held, the same worker holds the region's coarse lock; and a slot has an owning player exactly when it carries an allocator stamp, so ownership and allocation record never disagree.

---- MODULE W4Od3m4p0t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences

Instances == {"I1", "I2"}
Cap == 2
MaxSettled == 3

VARIABLES queue, ledgerHolder, posting, settled

vars == <<queue, ledgerHolder, posting, settled>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in Seq(Instances)
    /\ Len(queue) <= Cap
    /\ ledgerHolder \in Instances \cup {"none"}
    /\ posting \in BOOLEAN
    /\ settled \in 0..MaxSettled

Init ==
    /\ queue = << >>
    /\ ledgerHolder = "none"
    /\ posting = FALSE
    /\ settled = 0

Submit(inst) ==
    /\ Len(queue) < Cap
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, inst)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledgerHolder, posting, settled>>

AcquireLedger(inst) ==
    /\ ledgerHolder = "none"
    /\ ledgerHolder' = inst
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, posting, settled>>

BeginPost(inst) ==
    /\ ledgerHolder = inst
    /\ ~posting
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ posting' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, ledgerHolder, settled>>

CommitPost(inst) ==
    /\ ledgerHolder = inst
    /\ posting
    /\ settled < MaxSettled
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ settled' = settled + 1
    /\ posting' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED ledgerHolder

AbortPost(inst) ==
    /\ ledgerHolder = inst
    /\ posting
    /\ posting' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, ledgerHolder, settled>>

ReleaseLedger(inst) ==
    /\ ledgerHolder = inst
    /\ ~posting
    /\ ledgerHolder' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, posting, settled>>

Next ==
    \/ \E inst \in Instances : Submit(inst)
    \/ \E inst \in Instances : AcquireLedger(inst)
    \/ \E inst \in Instances : BeginPost(inst)
    \/ \E inst \in Instances : CommitPost(inst)
    \/ \E inst \in Instances : AbortPost(inst)
    \/ \E inst \in Instances : ReleaseLedger(inst)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LedgerMutex ==
    /\ Len(queue) <= Cap
    /\ posting => ledgerHolder # "none"
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LedgerMutex
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch is driven by two independent settlement instances, I1 and I2, that share one common pool: a single settlement ledger, which is the critical resource. Settlement requests from both instances land in one shared bounded work queue that applies backpressure: once it is full, no instance may submit another request until it drains.

Posting to the ledger is mutually exclusive. An instance must first acquire the shared ledger, and only one instance may hold it at a time. While holding the ledger an instance may begin posting the request at the head of the queue, then commit that post, which removes the request from the queue and advances the settled count. A post in progress is the critical section and can only occur while the instance holds the ledger. An instance may abandon a post in progress, and may release the ledger only when it is not mid-post.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The work queue never exceeds its capacity, and a post is ever in progress only while some instance holds the shared ledger, so ledger posting is never performed outside the critical section held by a single instance.
